title: Weather above, currents below
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.text: Clear skies. The first expedition left forty winters past, but only one returned.
Thunder over the valley. Lightning in the blood: telling blows land more often.
A cold wind brings the leaves down. The valley folk know a chill in the air means the deeper currents stir with life.
Steady rain. The herbs drink it up.
A cold wind brings the leaves down. The deep is quiet. A cool mist of loose qi drifts through the halls. Breathe deep.
Thunder over the valley. Lightning in the blood: telling blows land more often.
A cold wind brings the leaves down. Elder Mo's study in the old lodge is full of scrolls and secrets. Look behind the falling leaves, and you'll find a hidden door with a keyhole.
Steady rain. The herbs drink it up.
Thunder over the valley. Lightning in the blood: telling blows land more often.
Steady rain. The herbs drink it up. The valley's quiet, but underfoot, the stone stirs with the old rhythms: a tremor now and then means loose ore. Gather carefully.
Steady rain. The herbs drink it up.
Cold seep. The stone feels the chill, slowing those who dig and delve.
The deep is quiet. Listen for the shifting of the tortoise's breath. Shellhaven may be still, but the tortoise never sleeps.
Thick fog. Your spirit sense reaches further when your eyes can't.
